description:

----------------

We are seeking a highly qualified Pathologist to provide expert pathology review and support oncology pre‑clinical studies and clinical trials, serving as a subject matter expert for oncology assets and a key contributor to cross‑functional teams. The role involves supporting assay development using advanced pathology and molecular techniques, including IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, mRNA in situ hybridization, and digital pathology, to ensure clinical relevance and innovation. In addition, the 3 year fixed-term position drives continuous improvement in pathology workflows and advises leadership on future pathology and translational research strategies.

* Support research and development of primary antibodies, detection systems, probes, and special stains, ensuring alignment with clinical and translational goals.
* Contribute to the development and validation of novel assays using advanced platforms, including multiplex immunofluorescence (e.g., Comet), immunohistochemistry, mRNA in situ hybridization, and digital pathology.
* Drive innovation in molecular pathology and translational research through close collaboration with scientific teams to ensure clinical relevance and robust assay performance.

title: Lead Scientist - Functional Immunology*
description:
#### **Your mission**

As Lead Scientist – Functional Immunology you will join our research team in Vienna and help us bring next generation drugs from the bench into the clinic. In this position you will design, establish and execute functional assays, analyze and interpret data, and contribute to the translational evidence package supporting clinical proof-of-concept studies.  
  
Your main responsibilities will be:

* **In-house assay development.** Design, optimize, and execute *in vitro* functional assays to evaluate the activity of lead molecules and generate data to support mode of action studies and drug candidate selection, including immune and tumor cell co-culture systems for functional studies, T-cell activation assays and cytokine release assays
* **Cytokine biology.** Evaluate cytokine-mediated biological activity and support head-to-head selection of engineered cytokine variants, including JAK/STAT activation assays and receptor-bias characterization as well as T-cell activation assays
* **Mechanism-of-action and target-engagement studies.** Develop and execute *in vitro* studies to characterize target engagement, pharmacological profiling, and downstream biological responses of lead molecules.
* **CRO coordination.** Coordinate and oversee studies conducted with CRO partners, including *In vivo* efficacy models (e.g. humanized and knock-in mouse models) and e*x vivo* translational models (patient tumor fragments / organoids).
* **Data interpretation and communication.** Analyze and interpret the data, present it to the project team and management, and contribute to study design and program strategy.
* **Supervision and mentoring of lab technicians**

#### **Your profile**

**What you have to offer:**

  

* PhD in Immunology, Oncology, Cell Biology, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of relevant work experience following your PhD (preferably in a biotech or pharma setting).
* Hands-on expertise in immune-cell biology and cellular assay development.
* Practical experience with primary human immune cells, dendritic cells and T cells, multicolor flow cytometry, cytokine analysis, and functional immunology assays.
* Experience working with CROs and external collaborators.
* Good organizational, communication, and data-interpretation skills, and the ability to work well within a small team.
* Track record of scientific excellence, including publications and patent applications.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken).
* **Strong candidates will also offer one or more of the following:**
  + Experience with co-culture/tri-culture systems (e.g. dendritic cell–T cell–tumor).
  + Experience in early-stage drug discovery and preclinical development.
  + Familiarity with cytokine/cytokine-mutein biology, JAK/STAT signaling, and Treg vs. effector readouts.
  + Experience with *ex vivo* patient-tissue or organoid models.

#### **Why us?**

**Benefits for you.**

  

* Take responsibility for a key research field within Bio-LogX and bring new immunology based treatments to patients
* Lead and develop a team of highly skilled researchers and work closely with our bio-informatics, generative protein design and disease modeling teams.
* Pioneer new methods and processes to industrialize key research techniques.
* Be part of a highly motivated, multinational and fun team that believes protein based modalities can become next-generation medicines for patients.
* A **competitive compensation package that reflects the qualifications and seniority of the candidate** and may include further, e.g. performance-based, incentives. *Due to legal requirements, we are required to state that the* *minimum* *salary for this job is a monthly salary of EUR 4.500,- gross, where candidates with extensive experience can expect to earn EUR 5.500,- and more.*

#### **About us**

Bio-LogX FlexCo (currently being renamed to Sameric Bio), based at the Vienna Biocenter, is a VC-backed therapeutic engine. We develop drug candidates from animal to clinical proof of concept – always with the ambition to transform the standard of care. We are agnostic about therapeutic area but focus on protein modalities: antibodies, enzymes, fusions, engagers, degraders, agonists, antagonists.

How can we perform table-top experiments to obtain new insights into the foundations of quantum physics? Can we measure gravitational effects on entangled photons for shining light onto the interface of quantum physics and gravity? Can we exploit quantum photonics technology for novel quantum machine learning, quantum computing and quantum cybersecurity applications? Can we scale-up multiphoton platforms by using integrated optics, quantum-dot single-photon sources and customized two-dimensional nonlinear materials? Such questions are the driving force behind our research. You will be part of our team and develop new ideas, technologies and experiments.
  
  
**Your professional field of activity:**  
The research group “Quantum Information Science and Quantum Computation”, led by Univ.- Prof. Dr. Philip Walther, is part of the Quantum Science Group at the Faculty of Physics, and member of the Vienna Center for Quantum Science and Technology (VCQ) – one of the largest quantum hubs in Europe – and the Austrian Cluster of Excellence quanta. The group’s research combines the development of scalable photonic quantum technology for quantum computing and other quantum information applications with the investigation of fundamental quantum science questions. The main activities range from quantum control of single photons using solid-state photon sources, integrated waveguide technology, tailored nonlinear media and detectors based on superconductor technology to interferometric precision measurements of weak gravitational forces.

Among the many reasons to research and teach at the University of Vienna there is one in particular, which has convinced around 7,500 academic staff members so far. They see themselves as personalities who need space for continuous striving for top international research and scientific excellence. At the same time, they enjoy support and liberties that are not a given at other institutions. Does that sound like something for you? Welcome to our team!
  
The Max Perutz Labs bring together the groups working in molecular biology at the University of Vienna. In order to intensify the collaboration with the Medical University of Vienna in the field of molecular biosciences, the Max Perutz Labs were founded in 2005. We maintain high-tech research infrastructures at two neighbouring locations, where around 450 scientists from more than 40 nations work in basic biomedical research in more than 45 research groups.
  
  
**Your personal sphere of play:**  
The Matos laboratory is looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Scientist to combine active scientific research with a central role in the scientific and organizational management of the laboratory.
  
  
The position is initially limited to 3 years, with the possibility of permanent employment by mutual agreement pending financial availability and following a positive evaluation.
  
  
The Matos lab is an internationally competitive and collaborative research group investigating the molecular mechanisms that control meiotic chromosome organization and homologous recombination. We are particularly interested in understanding how recombination intermediates are formed and processed, how meiotic crossovers are generated, and how chromosome architecture and recombination are coordinated to ensure accurate chromosome segregation during gametogenesis. To address these questions, we combine genetics, molecular and cell biology, biochemistry, genomics and advanced imaging approaches in budding yeast and mammalian experimental systems.
  
The successful candidate will actively contribute to ongoing research while taking substantial responsibility for the scientific and organizational operation of the laboratory. The position is therefore particularly suited to an experienced scientist who enjoys experimental research but also takes satisfaction in supporting other scientists, solving scientific and technical problems, coordinating complex activities and ensuring that a highly collaborative laboratory operates effectively.
  
  
**Your future tasks:**  
The successful candidate will actively participate in research, teaching and administration and will take a leading role in the scientific and organizational management of the laboratory.
  
This involves conducting and supporting research projects in chromosome biology, meiosis and homologous recombination, including the planning, execution and interpretation of experiments. The Senior Scientist will contribute broad scientific and technical expertise to projects across the laboratory and help establish, optimize and maintain experimental methods and workflows.
  
An important part of the position will be to support the scientific development and day-to-day research activities of other members of the group, as well as teaching. This includes discussing experimental strategies, helping with troubleshooting and data interpretation, transferring expertise between projects and providing scientific and practical supervision to undergraduate, Master and PhD students as well as other researchers in the laboratory. The successful candidate will contribute to scientific publications, presentations and grant-related activities.
  
The position additionally includes substantial responsibility for the organization and management of the laboratory. The Senior Scientist will help coordinate laboratory workflows and shared resources, oversee laboratory organization, equipment and inventories, and coordinate purchasing and the availability of reagents and consumables. They will contribute to the implementation and documentation of laboratory procedures and help ensure that equipment, experimental resources and laboratory spaces are maintained and used effectively.
  
The successful candidate will coordinate the onboarding and offboarding of laboratory members and facilitate the transfer of knowledge, protocols and responsibilities within the group. They will act as an important interface between the laboratory, administrative staff, scientific core facilities and other research groups at the Max Perutz Labs and Vienna BioCenter.
  
Together with the group leader and other senior members of the laboratory, the Senior Scientist will contribute to the planning of laboratory resources and to maintaining an efficient, supportive and scientifically ambitious research environment.
  
The position also includes practical and theoretical teaching of undergraduate and graduate students in molecular biology, genetics and chromosome biology, mentoring and supervision of students, and occasional participation in scientific outreach activities.
  
  
**This is part of your personality:**  

* PhD degree in molecular biology, genetics, biochemistry or a related field.
* Strong scientific background in chromosome biology, meiosis, homologous recombination or related areas of molecular and cell biology.
* Extensive practical experience in molecular biology and genetics. Experience with budding yeast genetics and meiotic experimental systems is particularly beneficial.
* Broad experimental expertise and the ability to understand, discuss and support different research projects and experimental approaches.
* Strong publication record and demonstrated scientific track record.
* Experience in experimental design, troubleshooting, data interpretation and the development or optimization of experimental workflows.
* Strong motivation to support research projects and provide scientific and practical feedback to other members of the laboratory.
* Experience in mentoring and practical supervision of undergraduate, Master and/or PhD students.
* Experience in laboratory organization or management, including coordination of laboratory workflows, equipment, shared resources, reagents and purchasing.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to coordinate multiple scientific and operational activities in parallel.
* A high degree of independence, reliability and sense of responsibility.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills and enthusiasm for working in a collaborative and international research environment.
* Experience in teaching undergraduate and graduate students is beneficial.
* Excellent spoken and written English skills; German skills are beneficial.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Trinsik is an international business creation studio for organisations that want to move decisively into what's next. We design and implement the solutions — products, data pipelines, business models — that make new opportunities real. In complex markets, under real constraints, and at pace. That pace only holds if the numbers keep up — product performance, commercial traction, portfolio development. That's where you come in.

Tasks
We are looking for a Data Analyst with 3–5 years of experience to join our data team in Vienna. You will own the analytics layer in our client and venture projects, across three kinds of work: product analytics for the digital products we build, commercial analytics for new services and business models, and investment and portfolio analytics for our (Corporate) Venture Capital and Investment clients. You will work alongside our data engineers and get hands-on with the pipelines and models behind your dashboards.

Set up and run product analytics for our digital products and ventures: define the event and tracking concept, build funnel, retention, and cohort analyses, and answer why users do what they do.

Build the commercial analytics for new services — unit economics, pricing scenarios, contribution margin, adoption and revenue development — and make the numbers defensible for management-level decisions.

Work with our (Corporate) Venture Capital and Investment clients on the data models and reporting behind portfolio monitoring, performance tracking, and investment decision-making.

Write and optimise SQL for data models, transformations, and analyses — you are comfortable in the database, not just in the BI tool.

Support our data engineers on pipelines and the transformation layer: build models, add tests, fix data quality issues, extend existing flows.

Build and maintain dashboards and reports (primarily Power BI) that people actually use — for portfolio monitoring, product KPIs, and commercial performance.

Collaborate with stakeholders to define business metrics and KPIs, ensuring that data analytics aligns with strategic goals.

Continuously improve data quality, documentation, and governance across projects.

Own your workstream: break down the work, set your own priorities, keep timelines and dependencies visible, and coordinate with engineers, PMs, and the client.

Take a topic from the first requirements workshop to a running, documented solution, and share what you learn within the analytics community at Trinsik.

Requirements

3–5 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Analytics Engineer, or similar role.

Strong SQL — joins, CTEs, window functions, and enough understanding of query performance to know why something is slow.

Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, report creation) or comparable BI tools.

Solid understanding of data modeling (star schema / dimensional modeling), relational databases, and ETL/ELT processes.

Hands-on experience with product analytics and event tracking (GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog or similar), including the metrics that go with it — activation, retention, cohorts, funnels.

Comfortable with commercial metrics: unit economics, CAC/LTV, contribution margin, pricing logic.

You organise yourself: you can take an unclear requirement, structure it, and drive it without someone breaking it down for you.

Comfortable presenting your own results to client stakeholders.

Analytical mindset with a structured and solution-oriented approach.

Strong communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.

Completed IT-related education or equivalent qualification.

Excellent English skills; German is a plus.

Nice to have

Familiarity with investment or financial data (portfolio analytics, performance metrics, fund reporting).

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Fabric, dbt, Snowflake, or a similar modern data stack.

Python for data work.

Benefits

The Numbers: €55,000 – €65,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible working hours and home office to balance your life, while keeping a vibrant team dynamic in our offices.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere within the EU (up to 20 days/year) or take advantage of our sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps, and digital solutions with a ton of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: A well-established, experienced crew located in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears—whether it's about designs, business ideas, or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Our Process

We run a 3-stage process to get a clear picture of who you are — and to give you a clear picture of us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
About Fonio

We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe’s market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we’re expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe’s fastest-growing companies.

Your Role

As Revenue Operations Lead, you’re the analytical engine behind our revenue organization — and the closest thing our CCO has to a co-pilot.

You’ve done this before at a B2B SaaS scaleup. You know what happens to funnel definitions, forecasts, and reporting when a company multiplies revenue in a year — and you know how to keep the numbers true while everything around them changes. That’s exactly the situation here.

This is not a back-office function. You work directly with the CCO, you own the numbers behind every major GTM decision — channel mix, market expansion, headcount, pricing — and you’re expected to bring a view, not just a dashboard. When we ask “is France working?”, “where does our funnel leak?”, or “which partner actually drives revenue?” — you don’t guess. You know, and you already have a recommendation.

If you want to run analyses in peace, two layers away from the decisions, this is the wrong job. If you want your numbers to set the agenda in the room where decisions are made, it’s the right one.

What You’ll Do

Revenue performance: Own revenue performance across all channels and every funnel stage — direct sales, partnerships, self-serve, from first touch to closed-won and expansion. You define what we measure, how stages and pipelines work, and what “good” looks like. A dedicated ops team executes the changes in HubSpot — your time goes into analysis and decisions, not building workflows.
Headcount & revenue planning: Partner with the CCO on revenue and headcount planning — capacity models, ramp curves, quota coverage, and per-market hiring needs. When we decide how many reps a market gets next quarter, your model is the starting point.
Reporting & forecasting: Build and run the dashboards leadership actually uses — MRR, conversion rates per stage and rep, pipeline coverage, forecasts. Turn “we feel behind” into “here’s exactly what changed and why.”
International performance: Own the numbers for our expansion markets end-to-end. Track direct-sales performance per market and per rep, spot what’s working in one country and roll it out to the next.
Partnership performance: Build the reporting and operating cadence for our reseller and partner business — partner-sourced pipeline, activation, revenue attribution — and work directly with our Partnership team to double down on what performs.
AI-first operations: We don’t scale RevOps with headcount, we scale it with agents. You’ll build and run AI-powered reporting and analysis workflows (Claude, MCP integrations, automation) so a lean team operates like a big one.
GTM experiments: Partner with the CCO and country leads on pricing, comp, territory, and funnel experiments — and be the one who tells us, fast, whether they worked.

What You Bring

3+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a data-heavy GTM role in B2B SaaS — ideally through a scaleup phase where revenue multiplied fast and you kept the numbers true while everything changed. High-velocity SMB motion strongly preferred.
Deep CRM understanding (HubSpot ideally) — you’ve built reports, workflows, and data models hands-on before, so you can spec exactly what our ops team should build and challenge it when it’s wrong. You direct execution; you don’t sit in the ticket queue.
Strong analytical backbone: you’re fluent in funnel metrics, cohort thinking, and forecasting, and you communicate numbers so clearly that decisions follow.
Genuine excitement for AI tooling — you already use LLMs and automation in your daily work and want to push that much further.
Experience with international or multi-market GTM setups is a big plus; partnership/channel experience even more so.
Fluent English; German is a plus.
You run your area like it’s your company.

What You Get

€75.000–€110.000 depending on experience
Equity - you build it, you should own a piece of it
Direct collaboration with the CCO and both founders
A seat at the table for every major GTM decision - your numbers set the agenda
Modern high-end equipment, central office in Vienna’s 7th district with a big roof terrace, relocation support if you’re not based here

45 min skills interview 
Culture call with our founders

title: Machine Learning Software Engineer
description:
THE ROLE
You would join our quant team, alongside our data scientists and ML engineers. The team owns several forecasting and optimisation systems that sit in the core of the product: site and portfolio-level forecasts of PV generation and load, calibration of our asset models against how assets actually behave, detection of what equipment sits behind a meter, and the optimisation that turns all of that into dispatch and trading decisions.

This is the engineering half of that work. You would own and improve the production systems those models run in, and the frameworks the team builds them with. The models themselves stay with the data scientists.

For applicants based in Vienna; traveling to Antwerp, Belgium once a month is expected. Applicants in Belgium will also be considered. 

WHAT YOU'D WORK ON
Shared with the other ML engineers, and priorities move around, so read this as
examples rather than a fixed list.
> A backtesting framework. Judging a candidate forecaster today means shadow- running it in production for weeks. Proper data and model versioning, historical replay, and evaluation in euros rather than error metrics alone would let us settle those questions in an afternoon.

> Engineering practices inside a data science team: testing, structure, code review, reproducibility, and whatever keeps research code alive once it reaches production.

> The MLOps lifecycle. Data and model versioning, retraining, backfills, and the Airflow jobs that carry them.

> Operational stability. A good share of the team's time currently goes into fixing what broke. Instrumentation, alerting and sane failure behaviour give that time back.

> Meteo data ingestion, storage layout and query performance.

> Scalability. Assets under management should grow sharply and the pipelines need to hold up without a rewrite each time.

> Research quality of life, including squeezing more out of our backtests and Ray.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

> 2–5 years building and running production systems. Data engineering, backend or ML platform work all count. What matters is that you have operated something real, not only built it.
> Strong Python.
> Orchestration and cloud infrastructure. We run Airflow on GCP.
> Sound instincts on data modelling and storage, and a working understanding of database schemas and data structures.
> Enough ML familiarity to reason about training pipelines, feature computation
and evaluation. You do not need to have trained models professionally. Initiative on engineering quality. Nobody here will hand you a specification for it.
> Energy domain knowledge is a plus, not a requirement.

A PhD is not required and we would rather see production engineering mileage.
Applied research backgrounds are welcome, but this is an engineering role and will
be interviewed as one.

WORKS CLOSELY WITH
Data scientists and ML engineers on the quant team

STACK
Python, Airflow, GCP, Ray

WHY THIS IS WORTH DOING
The bottleneck on the team is not ideas.
Time goes into fixing what broke and into proving that a change actually
helped, and both of those are engineering problems. Solve them properly and the whole team gets its time back. You would also be shaping this function rather than inheriting someone else's version of it.

title: Senior Market Research Specialist:in – Data Analytics & Strategic Insights
description:
Der Lebensmittelhandel zählt zu den dynamischsten und wettbewerbsintensivsten Branchen Europas – und prägt mit seiner Innovationskraft das tägliche Leben von Millionen Menschen. Als eines der größten Handelsunternehmen in Zentral- und Osteuropa gestaltet die REWE Group die Transformation des Lebensmitteleinzelhandels aktiv mit und setzt dabei verstärkt auf datenbasierte Entscheidungen.

Im Bereich Market Research Handel International schaffen wir die Grundlage für fundierte strategische Weichenstellungen. Markt-, Kunden- und Wettbewerbsdaten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen werden hier zusammengeführt, analysiert und in entscheidungsrelevante Insights übersetzt. Mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch, modernen Analyse-Tools und einem tiefen Verständnis für Marktmechaniken unterstützen wir Management und Fachbereiche in Österreich sowie in den internationalen Märkten.

Als Senior Market Research Specialist:in – Data Analytics & Strategic Insights übernehmen Sie eine zentrale inhaltliche und strategische Rolle im Market-Research-Team. Sie steuern komplexe Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen eigenverantwortlich, entwickeln Analyse- und Reporting-Standards weiter und agieren als Sparringspartner:in für Management und Schlüssel-Stakeholder.

Sie übersetzen datengetriebene Erkenntnisse in klare Handlungsempfehlungen, treiben die Weiterentwicklung datenbasierter Entscheidungsprozesse voran und leisten damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur strategischen Ausrichtung des Unternehmens – national wie international.

Stellenbeschreibung

Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung und Durchführung komplexer Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen auf Basis externer Datenquellen (z. B. Nielsen, YouGov)
Interpretation, Kommentierung und strategische Einordnung von Analyseergebnissen für Management- und Entscheidungsrunden
Konzeption, Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von unternehmensweiten Reports, Dashboards und KPI-Systemen (insbesondere Power BI)
Definition und Sicherstellung von Analyse- und Reporting-Standards sowie Qualitätssicherung bestehender Reports
Übersetzung von Business- und Strategiefragen in analytische Konzepte und datengetriebene Entscheidungsgrundlagen
Beratung und Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Hierarchieebenen bis hin zur Managementebene
Fachliche Rolle im Team, inkl. Wissenstransfer, Coaching und Unterstützung weniger erfahrener Kolleg:innen
Konzeption, Aufbau und Roll-out internationaler Reporting- und Analyse-Frameworks
Länderübergreifender Support sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Einheiten
Mitarbeit und inhaltliche Verantwortung bei Management-Präsentationen und strategischen Entscheidungsunterlagen

Qualifikationen

Abgeschlossenes fachspezifisches Studium (ua. Wirtschaft, Psychologie, Statistik etc.)  
Mindestens 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich Market Research, Datenanalyse, Business Analytics, Consulting oder vergleichbaren Funktionen
Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Marktforschungsdaten (z. B. Nielsen, YouGov oder vergleichbare Anbieter)
Erfahrung im Handel oder in der Konsumgüterbranche von Vorteil
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI und MS Office
Strategisches und analytisches Denkvermögen mit hoher Business-Orientierung
Souveräne Beratungs‑ und Präsentationskompetenz gegenüber internen Stakeholdern und Management
Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Entscheidungsstärke und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
Teamorientierung, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Bereitschaft zum fachlichen Austausch

Zusätzliche Informationen

Langfristige, abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit bei einem verlässlichen Arbeitgeber in einem kollegialen Team
Familienfreundliche Unternehmenskultur mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice (Telearbeit) unter Berücksichtigung deiner individuellen Bedürfnisse
Zahlreiche Ausbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Konzern
Mitarbeiter:innen-Rabatte bei Einkauf und Reisen
Gute Erreichbarkeit und Parkplätze vor Ort
Ein marktkonformes, attraktives und leistungsbezogenes Bruttojahresgehalt ab 43.000 Euro (auf Vollzeitbasis) mit der Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung bei entsprechender Erfahrung und Qualifikation.

title: Market & Liquidity Risk Senior Expert*
description:
BAWAG Group is the publicly listed holding company of BAWAG, which, with more than 4 million customers, is one of the largest banks in Austria. As a dynamic employer, we promote talent and drive technological innovation forward at a rapid pace. Flat hierarchies, a flexible working environment, and equal opportunities for our employees are particularly important to us.

As part of our Market & Liquidity Risk Analysis team within the Enterprise Risk Management & Analytics division, you will play an active role in the ongoing management, analysis, and reporting of market and liquidity risks across the bank. This position is intended for senior risk professionals with extensive experience in banking risk management, who are motivated to shape risk methodologies, navigate complex regulatory requirements, and support strategic balance sheet and risk management decisions.

Your Responsibility

Lead the measurement, analysis and monitoring of market risks across the Group, with a particular focus on IRRBB (EVE, NII, behavioral models, hedging impacts), credit spread risk, basis risk and foreign exchange risk.
Take ownership of risk methodologies, assumptions, models and limit frameworks, ensuring their ongoing adequacy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.
Prepare risk analyses and management information for senior management, ALCO/SALCO and regulatory stakeholders, providing actionable insights and recommendations.
Actively support regulatory risk assessments and internal risk processes (e.g. ICAAP, ILAAP, stress testing, scenario analysis)
Participate in cross functional projects to implement regulatory changes, improve methodologies, and enhance risk systems and data flows
Contribute to liquidity risk analysis and reporting activities, supporting a holistic view of balance sheet risks across the Group.

Your Profile

University degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics or a comparable quantitative field
At least 5 years of professional experience in a bank or financial institution in Market / Liquidity Risk Management or Asset & Liability Management (ALM)
Deep understanding of IRRBB, credit spread risk, valuation concepts, balance sheet risk management and relevant regulatory requirements
Practical experience with SQL, R, Python, Power BI or comparable analytical tools
Experience with risk or ALM systems, such as OneSumX (Risk / ALM), Moody’s RiskAuthority, QRM, Sungard / FIS, Murex, or comparable platforms
Confident handling of large datasets and strong ability to translate analysis into clear, decision relevant insights
Structured, proactive, and independent working style, combined with strong teamwork skills
Very good command of English (spoken and written); German is an advantage

Our Offer

You will spend 50% of your working time in our modern and easily accessible office at Vienna Central Station. 
We support your personal development and career planning with an individual and attractive training program. Visit our BAWAG Academy and use our GoodHabitz elearning platform for both your professional and personal growth.
In addition, we offer a range of interesting and valuable additional benefits. 

For this position, the collective agreement stipulates a minimum annual gross salary of € 47.255,60 on a full-time basis. Depending on your experience and qualifications, we are willing to offer a higher salary.

Skúsenosti so štatistickými modelmi alebo Anomaly Detection v minulosti.
Ochota dochádzať do Viedne pravidelnejšie (onsite prítomnosť v Erste Group je klientom veľmi vítaná).

title: Data Platform Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
Gestalte moderne Datenlösungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden

Du kannst komplexe Daten- und Analytics-Themen verständlich machen, erkennst hinter einer fachlichen Anforderung die passende technische Lösung und fühlst dich sowohl im Kundengespräch als auch in Power BI oder Microsoft Fabric wohl?
Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Als Data Platform Consultant begleitest du unsere Kunden dabei, aus Daten funktionierende Lösungen und bessere Entscheidungen zu machen. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie. Du verstehst Anforderungen, entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden Lösungsansätze und begleitest deren Umsetzung – vom ersten Workshop über den Proof of Concept bis zur produktiven Lösung.

Dabei arbeitest du mit Technologien wie Microsoft Fabric, Power BI und Databricks und bringst gleichzeitig deine eigenen Ideen in den weiteren Ausbau unseres Data-Analytics-Bereichs ein.
Du musst dabei nicht jede Technologie bereits bis ins letzte Detail beherrschen. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du ein solides Verständnis für Daten und Analytics mitbringst, gerne mit Kunden arbeitest und Lust hast, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Für diese Position gilt je nach Aufgabenbereich und Erfahrung ein kollektivvertragliches Mindestgehalt ab € 3.954,- brutto monatlich auf Vollzeitbasis. Bei entsprechender Qualifikation und Verantwortung ist eine Einstufung in ST2 vorgesehen. Das Mindestgehalt beträgt dort € 4.611,- in der Regelstufe beziehungsweise € 5.444,- in der Erfahrungsstufe. Dein tatsächliches Gehaltspaket richtet sich nach deiner Erfahrung, deinem Know-how und dem Verantwortungsumfang der Position und wird individuell mit dir vereinbart.

Was du bei uns gestaltest:

Consulting & Lösungsdesign
Du führst Anforderungs- und Lösungsworkshops mit unseren Kunden durch.
Du verstehst fachliche Herausforderungen und übersetzt sie in tragfähige Daten-, BI- und Analytics-Lösungen.
Du entwickelst und präsentierst Lösungsvarianten und passende Architekturen.
Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Idee über Proof of Concepts bis zur Umsetzung.
Du berätst Kunden bei Technologieentscheidungen sowie zu Themen wie Data Governance und moderner Datenarchitektur.
Du unterstützt dabei, neue Ideen, Methoden und Angebote in unserem Data-Analytics-Bereich weiterzuentwickeln.

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
Du konzipierst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Reports, Dashboards und Analytics-Lösungen mit Power BI.
Du entwickelst Datenmodelle, die fachlich verständlich, performant und langfristig wartbar sind.
Du verbindest und strukturierst Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen.
Du unterstützt Kunden beim Aufbau von Reporting- und Self-Service-BI-Lösungen.
Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Daten nicht nur schöne Dashboards, sondern tatsächlich relevante Erkenntnisse entstehen.

Modern Data Platforms
Du begleitest End-to-End-Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric - von der Datenquelle bis zum fertigen Reporting.
Du arbeitest mit Daten aus Systemen wie SQL Server, Snowflake, ERP- oder CRM-Lösungen.
Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei Datenmanagement, Datenmodellierung, Data Warehousing und modernen Lakehouse-Architekturen.
Je nach Projekt und deinem Schwerpunkt arbeitest du dabei selbst hands-on oder eng mit unseren Data Engineers zusammen.

Wenn es zu deinem Profil passt und dir Freude macht, kannst du dein Wissen außerdem in Schulungen, Fachvorträgen, Webinaren oder auf Veranstaltungen weitergeben. Wichtiger als ein bestimmter Ausbildungsweg ist für uns, dass du Daten verstehst und dieses Verständnis in gute Lösungen übersetzen kannst.

Das solltest du mitbringen:
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit IT-Schwerpunkt von Vorteil und gutes technisches Verständnis
Erfahrung mit Power BI, Power Query und Datenmodellierung
Kenntnisse in SQL und im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken
Verständnis moderner Datenarchitekturen wie Data Warehouse, Data Lake und Data Lakehouse
Erfahrung mit Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Dataflows oder Datenpipelines von Vorteil
Freude an der Beratung und daran, fachliche Anforderungen in passende Lösungen zu übersetzen
Strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
Kommunikationsstärke und sicheres Auftreten in Meetings, Workshops und Präsentationen
Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:
Bei uns bekommst du nicht einfach das nächste Reporting-Projekt. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Lösungen mitzugestalten und unseren Data-Analytics-Bereich gemeinsam mit uns weiterzuentwickeln.

Gestaltungsspielraum: Deine Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht – fachlich, technisch und bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots.
Moderne Technologien: Du arbeitest mit Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks und modernen Data-Platform-Architekturen.
Abwechslungsreiche Projekte: Unterschiedliche Unternehmen, Branchen und fachliche Herausforderungen sorgen dafür, dass es nicht bei einem einzigen Use Case bleibt.
Weiterentwicklung: Wir unterstützen dich mit gezielter Weiterbildung und relevanten Zertifizierungen.
Erfahrenes Team: Du arbeitest mit Kolleg:innen zusammen, mit denen du Wissen teilen, Lösungen diskutieren und dich fachlich weiterentwickeln kannst.
Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 60 % Mobile Working geben dir Spielraum bei der Gestaltung deines Arbeitsalltags.
Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und kannst Entscheidungen und Ideen direkt einbringen.
Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit zählt: unkompliziert, wertschätzend und mit Freude an guten Lösungen.
Work-Life-Balance: Teilzeit ab 30h/Woche sind für uns ebenfalls denkbar
Standorte: Linz, Wien oder Graz

Als Teil der Bechtle-Gruppe verbinden wir dabei die Flexibilität und Spezialisierung eines österreichischen IT-Unternehmens mit den Möglichkeiten und der Stabilität eines internationalen Technologieunternehmens.

You'll drive the re-imagining of our recommendation landscape: a project that will change how millions of people experience kununu. title: Postdoctoral Researcher (Quantitative Methods) (m/f/d)
location: Krems an der Donau, Lower Austria, Austria
description:
Job Description:
University for Continuing Education Krems
 
 The University for Continuing Education Krems specializes in part-time academic continuing education. As a public university, it works with its expertise in teaching and research to overcome societal challenges. The university combines many years of experience in continuing academic education with innovation and the highest quality standards in research and teaching. 
As an employer, we offer around 700 employees an inspiring and flexible working environment in the unique Wachau World Heritage region.
 The following position is available in the Department for Migration and Globalisation at the Faculty of Business and Globalisation: 
 
 
 
 
 
 Postdoctoral Researcher (Quantitative Methods) (m/f/d) 
 
 
 40 hrs./week
Advertisement No. SB26-0125
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We are seeking an outstanding Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in quantitative methods, survey research and causal inference to join the international ERC-funded research project MixedRivals, led by Assoc. Prof. Heidrun Bohnet. The position is expected to start on 1 January 2027.

About the project
The ERC project “Mixed (ar)rivals: Perceptions of Threat, Inequality, and the Risk of Violence between Different (Forced) Migrant Groups in North Africa” (MixedRivals) investigates relations between different (forced) migrant groups and the conditions under which these relations become conflictual or, alternatively, foster solidarity and social cohesion (see also: mixedrivals.com). In particular, the project examines how perceived threats, inequalities and competition shape inter-migrant relations and how these dynamics may contribute to social tensions, violence or cohesion.
 MixedRivals employs a comparative mixed-methods design, combining qualitative and quantitative research across five North African cities. Now in its third year, the project has collected qualitative data in Tunisia and Egypt, with qualitative data collection in Morocco forthcoming. Building on these insights, the project is expanding its quantitative component across Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt, combining survey research and embedded survey experiments.
 MixedRivals is carried out by an international and collaborative team consisting of the Principal Investigator, a research assistant, a PhD candidate, two postdoctoral researchers, and a project and communications manager. 
Your role
 As a postdoctoral researcher in the project, you take a leading role in the design, implementation and analysis of quantitative survey research on migration and inter-group relations in North Africa. Working closely with the Principal Investigator (PI) and an interdisciplinary international research team, you will co-lead the quantitative research across Morocco, Tunisia and Egypt, contribute to the project’s theoretical development, and develop high-quality international publications from the resulting data.

 In this position you will 
Survey leadership
Design and implement online surveys and embedded survey experiments (e.g. vignette and conjoint experiments) in LimeSurvey.
Lead questionnaire development in close consultation with the Principal Investigator (PI).
Coordinate survey implementation across Tunisia, Egypt, and Morocco, including social media-based participant recruitment.
Lead the analysis of survey and experimental data using advanced quantitative methods.
Data collection
Oversee the implementation of face-to-face survey in cooperation with a survey company in Morocco.
Ensure high standards of data quality, research ethics compliance and data management throughout the data collection process.
Contribute to and co-manage the coding of de facto (forced) migration policy data.
Research
Develop and submit at least two articles to leading international peer-reviewed journals based on the survey data, in co-authorship with the PI.
Contribute to theoretical development within the project and to further publications arising from MixedRivals.
Collaboration
Present project findings at international conferences, workshops and other academic events.
Contribute actively to project meetings, workshops, project documentation and grant reporting.
Collaborate closely with an interdisciplinary and international research team.

Your profile
We require evidence of the following qualifications for the application:
 
 Completed PhD in political science, conflict studies, social psychology, or a related social science discipline, preferably with distinction (the PhD degree must be awarded at the latest by 15th of December 2026).
Advanced expertise in quantitative methods, including inferential statistics and causal inference.
Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation and analysis of online surveys and survey experiments, combined with advanced quantitative skills in R and/or Stata.
A strong publication record in international peer-reviewed journals, appropriate to career stage, together with excellent analytical and academic writing skills.
Excellent command of English (minimum C1), both written and spoken. 
Strong organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international research team. 
Willingness to relocate to Austria and work regularly on site at Campus Krems.
 
 
 In addition, the following criteria are desirable:
 
 Previous research on inter-group perceptions, inequalities, (forced) migration and/or violence
Knowledge of or experience in North Africa, particularly Morocco
Knowledge of de facto migration policies in Africa
Experience with LimeSurvey or comparable survey software. 
Knowledge of qualitative research methods (e.g. interviews) and/or qualitative analysis software such as MAXQDA
Programming skills (e.g. Python)
Knowledge of French and/or Arabic
Previous experience working in international collaborative research projects

Your perspective
Full-time position (40 hours/week), initially limited to two years.
Minimum salary of EUR 5,014.30 gross per month (paid 14 times per year) on a full-time basis. 
Classification as a scientific project staff member according to § 49 VwGr. B1, of the Collective Agreement for University Staff (Kollektivvertrag für Universitäten) 
Innovative and international working environment at the Campus Krems
Flexible working hours and the option to work from home by agreement with line manager
Comprehensive training, professional development and coaching opportunities
Family-friendly working conditions and a wide range of services supporting work-life balance
Workplace health promotion programmes and a range of activities offered by the University Sports Institute (USI)
The Department for Migration and Globalisation is highly successful in acquiring third-party research funding: The department has led and contributed to many national and international research projects over the last 10 years and coordinated as well as co-operated in many European projects, which will allow the postdoctoral researcher to engage and exchange with colleagues on ongoing research. 
The University for Continuing Education Krems, located near Vienna, sees high innovation potential in the diversity of its employees and is committed to diversity as a guiding principle. We therefore explicitly invite people with disabilities and/or chronic illnesses who meet the required profile criteria to apply for the position. 

Contact:
 
 
 We look forward to receiving your compelling online application by 7 October 2026 via our online tool: https://www.donau-uni.ac.at/vacancies
 In order for your application to be considered, the following documents must be submitted: 
 Curriculum Vitae, including publication list and contact details for two or three references
Motivation letter clearly explaining how you could contribute to the project tasks and how the position fits with your previous and future research agenda
Two writing samples, preferably first-authored peer-reviewed publications or single-authored academic work (e.g. a chapter of your PhD thesis or a scientific article)
A brief description of your previous survey research experience, including the surveys and/or datasets you have worked with and your role in their design, implementation and/or analysis, together with appropriate supporting evidence where available
Copies of degrees and transcripts
The selection process will consist of two interview rounds. The first round is scheduled to take place via Zoom in October 2026. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a second interview a few weeks later.

description:

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Servus, hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

At Canva, our mission is to empower the world to design. We’re building AI that feels magical and lands real impact for millions of people - helping anyone create with confidence. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to own the data foundations that power our multimodal agent research—building the pipelines, datasets, and tooling that turn ambitious research ideas into trainable reality.

About The Team

We explore multimodal agentic architectures, build scalable training and evaluation loops, and partner closely with product and platform teams to turn breakthroughs into delightful product features. We are a cutting-edge research team, developing new multimodal agentic systems. We work on all topics of multimodal modelling, pre/post-training and design agents, we build scalable training and evaluation loops, and partner closely with product and platform teams to turn breakthroughs into delightful product features.

About The Role

You'll be responsible for the data lifecycle that fuels our agent research: from collection and curation through to preprocessing, quality assurance, and delivery into training pipelines. You'll work closely with research scientists to understand what data is needed, then design and build the systems to make it happen—reliably and at scale. You'll have significant autonomy over how data problems get solved, while aligning on what problems matter most with the broader team.

What You'll Do

Design and build data pipelines for agent training: collection, filtering, deduplication, formatting, and versioning across text, image, and multimodal sources.
Build and maintain infrastructure for efficient data loading, storage, and retrieval at scale (S3, distributed systems, streaming pipelines).
Collaborate with research scientists to translate research requirements into concrete data specifications, and iterate as experiments reveal new needs.
Create evaluation datasets and benchmarks in collaboration with researchers—curating task distributions that surface real failure modes.
Develop tooling for dataset construction—including human annotation workflows, synthetic data generation, and preference data collection for RLHF/DPO-style training.
Own data quality: build validation frameworks, monitor for drift and contamination, and establish standards that make datasets trustworthy and reproducible.
Document datasets thoroughly: provenance, known limitations, intended use cases, and versioning history.
Implement comprehensive test coverage for data pipelines and ML workflows, ensuring reliability and catching regressions early.
Elevate codebase quality through code reviews, refactoring, and establishing engineering best practices that help research velocity scale sustainably.
Contribute to team roadmaps by identifying data bottlenecks and proposing solutions that unblock research velocity.

You're likely a match if you have

Strong software engineering skills in Python, with experience building production-grade data pipelines and ML DevOps.
Practical experience with prompt engineering—designing, testing, and refining prompts for reliable LLM/VLM outputs.
Experience with ML data workflows: large-scale data processing and loading (Ray, or similar), data versioning, and format considerations for training (tokenization, batching, sharding).
Hands-on experience working with data pipelines for large-scale distributed ML training runs.
Familiarity with annotation tooling and human-in-the-loop data collection (Label Studio or internal systems).
Understanding of ML training requirements—you know what "good data" looks like for LLM/VLM fine-tuning and can anticipate downstream issues.
Experience loading and writing large datasets to/from cloud infrastructure (AWS) and distributed storage systems.
Strong communication skills: you can work with researchers to scope ambiguous problems and translate needs into actionable plans.
A collaborative approach, comfortable taking ownership and iterating quickly.

Nice to have

Experience with preference data collection for RLHF or reward modelling.
Familiarity with multimodal data (image-text pairs, video, design assets).
Experience building synthetic data generation pipelines using LLMs.
Background in data quality metrics and monitoring systems.
Contributions to dataset releases or benchmarks in the ML community.

title: Data & Business Intelligence Specialist (m/w/x)
description:
Join us and discover the Beauty of Simplicity.

Bei LARS NYSØM verbinden wir modernes, minimalistisches Design mit hervorragender Funktionalität und bringen so Schönheit in alltägliche Gegenstände. Seit 2017 haben unsere mehrfach ausgezeichneten Produkte über 1.000.000 Kund:innen weltweit überzeugt – über Amazon in der EU, in UK, den USA, Kanada und Australien, über bol.com, Otto und unseren eigenen Shopify-Store.

Wir sind ein wachsendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen mit Sitz in Wien. Unser Team rund um die Gründer Patrick Fischer und Sebastian Fritz sucht Verstärkung für den Aufbau unseres Datenbereichs.

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren ein Data Warehouse auf SQL Server in der Azure-Cloud aufgebaut, in das sämtliche Absatz-, Report- und Lagerdaten aus unseren Marktplätzen automatisiert synchronisiert werden. Die technische Umsetzung dieser Pipelines liegt bei einem erfahrenen externen Data Engineer und bleibt dort. Was bisher fehlt, ist die Person im Haus, die diese Daten fachlich verantwortet, Dashboards und Analysen baut, die das Unternehmen tatsächlich steuern, und der Geschäftsführung im Controlling zur Seite steht.

Wien · Vollzeit (38,5 h, All-In) · Hybrid: 3–4 Tage im Büro, 1–2 Tage remote

DEINE AUFGABEN BEI LARS NYSØM

Datenqualität & Steuerung des Data Engineering
• Du bist die fachliche Anlaufstelle für unser Data Warehouse (Datenmodell, Definitionen, Kennzahlenlogik), sammelst und priorisierst Anforderungen an neue Datenquellen und Synchronisierungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung durch unseren externen Data Engineer (Briefing, Abnahme, Tests).
• Die Data Pipelines (neue Datenquellen) kommen von unserem externen Data Engineer; das Staging und die Weiterverarbeitung der Daten im SQL Server übernimmst du selbst oder gemeinsam mit ihm – vor allem über Stored Procedures und Views.
• Du sorgst für Datenkonsistenz und -qualität: Plausibilitätsprüfungen, Abgleich zwischen Marktplatz-Reports, Warehouse und Buchhaltung, Monitoring von Pipelines und Ausfällen.

Business Intelligence & Dashboards
Du bist Sparringpartner für alle Abteilungen (Marketplace-Management, Einkauf/Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance), hinterfragst Anforderungen, übersetzt sie in Kennzahlen und lieferst Lösungen.
Du konzipierst Dashboards gemeinsam mit den Business-Units: Mockups und Konzepte zur Vorabstimmung der Anforderungen, bevor gebaut wird – damit am Ende das Richtige auf dem Bildschirm steht.
Du setzt Dashboards und Analyse-Tools KI-gestützt mit Claude Code um (JavaScript-Frontends, Python-Backends) und hostest sie in unserer Azure-Umgebung.
Du erkennst proaktiv, wo Daten Entscheidungen verbessern könnten, baust die Lösung und bringst sie ins Team – ohne auf einen Auftrag zu warten.

Controlling
Du baust ein regelmäßiges Management-Reporting auf (Absatz, Deckungsbeitrag je SKU/Marktplatz/Land, Lagerreichweiten, Werbekosten, Retouren), unterstützt Forecast, Budget und Soll-Ist-Analysen und bereitest Handlungsempfehlungen für die Geschäftsführung vor.

DEINE STÄRKEN & QUALIFIKATIONEN

Abgeschlossene IT-HTL (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medientechnik o. Ä.), ein einschlägiges Studium oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation – uns interessiert, was du kannst
Mindestens 2–3 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in BI, Data Analytics, Reporting oder Controlling
Sehr gutes SQL, idealerweise T-SQL auf SQL Server, inklusive Stored Procedures und Views für Staging und Datenaufbereitung
Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Dashboards: Du weißt, welche Kennzahlen auf welche Fläche gehören, wie man Anforderungen in ein Mockup übersetzt und wann ein Dashboard mehr verwirrt als hilft. Die Umsetzung erfolgt bei uns KI-gestützt mit Claude Code (JavaScript-Frontends, Python-Backends) – tiefe Programmiererfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung, technisches Verständnis schon
Grundkenntnisse in Python oder JavaScript von Vorteil, z. B. für Azure Function Apps oder kleinere Anpassungen
Offenheit für KI-gestütztes Arbeiten (Claude Code, Copilot o. Ä.) und Grundverständnis von Cloud-Umgebungen, bevorzugt Azure
Verständnis für E-Commerce-Kennzahlen und Interesse an betriebswirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen
Du formulierst Anforderungen präzise und diskutierst mit einem Data Engineer auf Augenhöhe – ohne selbst die Pipelines schreiben zu müssen
Hands-on-Mentalität, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Auge fürs Detail, gesunde Skepsis gegenüber Zahlen, die zu gut aussehen
Ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Amazon Seller Central und der Amazon SP-API (Reports, Settlements, Inventory), mit Otto oder bol.com, Kenntnisse in Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung, Aufbau von Reporting-Strukturen in einem KMU

WIR BIETEN

Hohes Maß an Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an – du baust den Datenbereich auf, statt ihn zu übernehmen
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern und Bereichsleitern von LARS NYSØM und kurze Entscheidungswege
Ein sauber aufgesetztes Data Warehouse als Basis: SQL Server auf Azure, Azure Functions (Python), JavaScript-Dashboards, Claude Code
Einbringen und Verwirklichung eigener Ideen
Positives, dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
Zentrale Lage im Herzen von Wien (Nähe Schwedenplatz/Urania), 3–4 Tage im Büro, 1–2 Tage remote
Mitarbeiterrabatt auf das gesamte Sortiment
Beginn: so bald wie möglich

Gehalt: Für diese Position gilt der Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Handel; das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt beträgt EUR 2.535,– brutto/Monat (Vollzeit, Stand 2026). Wir bieten ein All-In-Bruttojahresgehalt von EUR 50.000,– bis EUR 62.000,– je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung, mit Bereitschaft zur weitergehenden Überzahlung.

BEWIRB DICH JETZT

Wenn du bereit bist, Verantwortung für unsere Daten zu übernehmen, freuen wir uns auf dich. Bewirb dich direkt hier über LinkedIn mit deinem Lebenslauf – statt eines Anschreibens interessiert uns ein Beispiel für ein Dashboard, ein Reporting oder eine Analyse, auf die du stolz bist (Screenshot, Repo-Link oder kurze Beschreibung reicht). Fragen vorab gern an jobs@larsnysom.com.

description:

Zahlreiche Benefits & Social Events

Entwicklung von Dashboards, Stories und Anwendungen in der SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)
Gestaltung und Implementierung von SAC-Planungsszenarien (Modellierung, Datenaktionen, Prozesse)
Durchführung von Anforderungs- und Design-Workshops, Stakeholder-Management
Technische und fachliche Streamlead-Verantwortung inkl. Koordination von Teilteams
Qualitätssicherung, Best Practices, Dokumentation und Knowledge-Transfer 
Einsatz moderner (AI‑gestützter) Tools zur Optimierung von Arbeitsprozessen

Kompetenzen

Tiefes Know-How in der Datenmodellierung mit SAP BW (inkl. LSA/LSA++) und SAP Datasphere
Fundierte Erfahrung in der Frontend-Entwicklung mit SAC (Story-Design, Analytics Designer, Berechtigungen)
Idealerweise Kenntnisse in SAP Business Data Cloud inkl. Integration mit SAP Databricks
Expertise in SAC-Planung (Planungsmodelle, Versionen, treiberbasierte Planung, Integration mit BW/Datasphere)
Sicher in Workshop-Moderation, Requirements-Engineering und agilen Methoden
Offenheit gegenüber dem Einsatz von Artificial Intelligence (AI) sowie die Bereitschaft, AI‑Tools aktiv und verantwortungsvoll im Arbeitsalltag zu nutzen
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenz, proaktives Stakeholder-Management
Deutsch und Englisch fließend und hohe Kundenorientierung

Bei Fragen zu Barrierefreiheit oder Inklusion bei KPMG steht das Recruiting-Team zur Verfügung.

Das Mindestentgelt für diese Position beträgt EUR 60.000,-- brutto/Jahr (All-In). Bei entsprechender Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung besteht die Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung. Weiters kannst Du in allen genannten Karrierelevels mit einer leistungsabhängigen, individuellen Prämie rechnen. Senior Consultant im Bereich SAP Data & Analytics
